title: Verb tense: past, future and the -ing continuous form

blocks.content: A verb changes its form to tell us WHEN something happens — in the past, now, or in the future. Getting the tense right keeps your writing clear.
Make the simple past of most verbs by adding -ed: today I walk, yesterday I walked.

blocks.explain: Add -ed to make the simple past of 'play': played.
blocks.rule: Make the simple past of most verbs by adding -ed.

blocks.content: The continuous form shows an action happening now: add -ing to the verb (is playing, are running).

blocks.prompt: Right now she is ___ a song. (sing)
blocks.explain: Add -ing to show the action is happening now: singing.
blocks.rule: The continuous form adds -ing to the verb to show an action happening now.

blocks.content: Past adds -ed, the continuous adds -ing, and the future uses 'will'. Match the tense to the time. Let's practise!
